project.name: agents-memory
project.description: Unified agent memory (ADR-0028), package com.agenticai.core.agents.memorystore: the feature gate (platform AND tenant AND agent, default OFF), the recall composer that merges every registered MemoryRecallSource under one token budget, and the proposal policy/sink (proposals only, never ACTIVE). Depends on agents (the memory.spi ports) and nothing in the turn path: it must not depend on agents-turn, which depends on the spi instead and contributes SemanticMemorySource. No tables yet (V681/V682 come with WP3).
